content.text:
## What happened

The site's webfont was never loading. In `site/css/tokens.css`, the `@font-face` rule pointed to `../font/acme-sans.woff2` (singular), but the file lives at `site/fonts/acme-sans.woff2` (plural). That URL returned **404**, so every page silently fell back from *Acme Sans* to the system font — which changed the typography on all six pages at both breakpoints.

The visual run captured this as a site-wide "unhealthy capture":

| Snapshot group | Pixel diff |
|---|---|
| about | 2.35% desktop / 15.18% phone |
| contact | 2.72% / 5.32% |
| home | 3.02% / 5.12% |
| orders | 2.49% / 4.96% |
| pricing | 3.01% / 6.98% |
| products | 2.61% / 13.73% |

## The fix

One line in `site/css/tokens.css:5`:

```diff
-  src: url('../font/acme-sans.woff2') format('woff2');
+  src: url('../fonts/acme-sans.woff2') format('woff2');
```

## Verification

- `npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts` → **12/12 passed, 0 changed**
- `npx playwright test tests/functional.spec.ts` → **16/16 passed**

No baselines were approved or modified — the pages now match the existing approved screenshots, confirming this was purely the broken font path and nothing else.

STATUS: DONE
